Prior source-surface scope: Full documented-operation parity for the Gorgias REST API. 114 documented operations, re-derived 2026-08-07 from the provider's stable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (gorgias-rest-api.json, ReadMe docs version 1.5.1), fetched via https://dash.readme.com/api/v1/api-registry/1qfhqbgmshn434r: 61 paths, 114 operations (GET 46, POST 23, PUT 27, DELETE 18), 1 deprecated (still counted). There is no top-level webhooks block and no webhook management surface. Every endpoint below is partitioned exactly once.

operation.reason: 'Update customer field value' sends a bare top-level JSON scalar (string, integer, or boolean per its oneOf request schema) as the ENTIRE request body, not an object of record fields. This repository's write body_type dialect (json/form/json_array/multipart/base64_upload) always produces an object or array wrapper and has no mode for a bare scalar body. Source: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/update-customer-custom-field-value
operation.notes: named_dependency=a write body_type that sends a bare top-level JSON scalar rather than an object or array; artifact=https://dash.readme.com/api/v1/api-registry/1qfhqbgmshn434r

operation.reason: 'Retrieve a statistic' requires a top-level 'query' field whose schema is a 50-arm discriminated union implementing the Statistics API's recursive filter-expression grammar (and/or/comparison nodes), with no typed scalar leaf and no neutral empty default. This repository's authoring rule for an implemented direct-read POST command requires every required operations.json rest.body_schema path to be satisfied by a static rest.body or a required command flag mapped to body.*; no single flag or static literal can honestly stand in for an arbitrary filter tree. Source: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/get-statistic
operation.notes: named_dependency=a structured filter-expression command input (a DSL flag/builder) for the Statistics query grammar; artifact=https://dash.readme.com/api/v1/api-registry/1qfhqbgmshn434r

operation.reason: 'Download a statistic' returns text/csv from a POST request that carries a required JSON filter body. This repository's binary download executor (engine.OperationBinaryDownload / commandrunner.validateBinaryDownloadCommand) requires GET, so a POST-triggered CSV export cannot be wired through it. Source: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/download-legacy-statistic
operation.notes: named_dependency=a POST-capable binary/CSV download executor (the binary_download kind is GET-only today); artifact=https://dash.readme.com/api/v1/api-registry/1qfhqbgmshn434r

Source: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/list-ticket-messages

operation.reason: 'Search for view's items' takes its filter/order criteria in a request body but the provider requires PUT, not GET or POST. This repository's operation direct-read executor (commandrunner.validateOperationDirectReadCommand) accepts only GET or POST endpoints, so a PUT-bodied read cannot be wired through it. The common case (an unfiltered, cursor-paginated listing of a view's items) is already served by the GET sibling, implemented here as the 'views items list' direct read. Source: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/update-view-items
operation.notes: named_dependency=a PUT-capable operation direct-read executor (the runtime accepts only GET or POST today); artifact=https://dash.readme.com/api/v1/api-registry/1qfhqbgmshn434r
